capabilities: Fetch a configured GitHub repository folder into a local Obsidian cache
Configure multiple projects with repository, branch, KB root, and destination folder
Refresh caches manually per project, for all projects, or on startup
Store the GitHub token in Obsidian SecretStorage instead of plugin data
Skip unchanged downloads using upstream blob SHAs and remove locally deleted files
extras: Early internal release; the README advises validating with a test vault before using an important vault. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Private repositories need a fine-grained GitHub personal access token with read-only contents permission.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull just one folder of a GitHub repository as readable notes without cloning the whole repo or using a Git executable, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: Sparkore KB Reader connects only to GitHub APIs required to read configured repositories.

summary: Read-only GitHub folder reader that downloads selected knowledge base folders from a repository into a local Obsidian cache, built for mobile.
